findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "best_deals" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Discounted departures of this site's yachts, read from the live inventory: only a discount the source itself states (a special, or a price under its list price)…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Ask this site's desk for a formal quote on one or more yachts, for the person. Pass the page links a search, best_deals or get returned, the days and the party,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_yachts, best_deals, request_quote · Private data: search_yachts, get_yacht, price_range, best_deals · Public sink: search_yachts, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_yachts, best_deals, request_quote · Private data: search_yachts, get_yacht, price_range, best_deals · Public sink: search_yachts, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
